Shopping cart: daily challenge, 2026-11-05

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-11-05: Shopping cart. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free with a Google or GitHub account.

Open the challenge

Shoppers browse products, drop things in a cart and come back later from another phone. Browsing is most of the traffic and can be a little old. The cart itself must always show what the shopper just added.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
